about.photo_alt: Western Edge climber at work in a large oak
about.title: Trees, rigging and machinery, all in one place
paragraphs: Trees, high-angle rigging and machinery have been recurring themes for Scott Paider, and Western Edge Tree Service is where they all come together.

From USFS wildland fire crew to welding and steel construction, Scott has put his hands to work in the air and on the ground for many years. After a decade rigging highline camera systems and stunt safety in the film industry, he brought together his working knowledge of forestry, rigging and high-angle safety in the form of Western Edge.

Scott has been a Gorge resident and arborist since 1995 and started Western Edge in 2007. We have certified arborists on staff, are members of the International Society of Arboriculture, and are licensed, bonded and insured in Oregon and Washington.

services.name: Large Tree Removal
services.blurb: Trees of all sizes, with bucket trucks, climbers or a crane.
services.intro: Large trees require special attention and experience to remove safely. Your job may require a bucket truck, certified tree climbers, or crane-assisted removal. We always find the most efficient and cost-effective option for your project.
photos: Climber taking down a tall pine
Crane lifting a section of trunk
Bucket truck cutting a trunk in sections

services.name: Tree Pruning
services.blurb: For view enhancement, tree health and general safety.
services.intro: Trees of all ages may require pruning to some degree. Under the supervision of our certified arborists, we can prune your trees for view enhancement, tree health and general safety concerns.
photos: Climber high in a forest canopy

services.name: Cabling & Bracing
services.blurb: Extra support to preserve trees that need it.
services.intro: Cabling and bracing are two methods we use to preserve trees that require additional support. We primarily use dynamic cabling, which lets the tree move naturally while still giving it the support it needs during extreme weather, and limits damage to its surroundings in the event of a failure.
includes: Bracing with high tensile strength threaded rod
Keeping splitting trees from splitting further
photos: Support cable installed between pine limbs

services.name: Stump Grinding
services.blurb: Stumps ground 1 to 2 feet below grade, with full clean-up.
services.intro: We offer stump grinding to remove the stump 1 to 2 feet below grade, plus wood chipping and full clean-up services to keep your property looking its best.
includes: Stumps ground 1 to 2 feet below grade
photos: Stump grinder working in a landscaped yard

services.name: Storm Damage Cleanup
services.blurb: Before and after the Gorge's wind and ice storms.
services.intro: The Gorge is infamous for its strong winds and ice storms. We can assess your property before storm season for preventive measures, and clean up storm damage after the event, day or night.
includes: Trees on homes, fences and roads

services.name: Lot & View Clearing
services.blurb: Room for your new home, or your view back.
services.intro: From residential view enhancement to lot clearing, we can make the improvements and changes you need for building your new home or enhancing your property value. We'll work with you to lay out a creative plan that suits your goals.
includes: A plan built around your goals
photos: Cleared lot with logs stacked in rows
